Mountain.description: Generates individual mountain peak terrain with configurable style and bulk

Combine multiple Mountains with Combine for ranges
Use as base shape before erosion

MountainRange.description: Creates extended mountain range formations with multiple peaks

MountainSide.description: Generates mountain slope terrain for side-view compositions

Perlin.description: Perlin noise generator for base terrain or detail overlays

Use as foundation blended with Mountains

MultiFractal.description: Multi-scale fractal noise with FBM, Billowy, and Ridged variants
tips: Ridged creates sharp mountain-like features

Voronoi.description: Voronoi cell patterns for cracked/tiled terrain

CraterField.description: Multiple crater generation for volcanic or impact terrain

Canyon.description: Canyon formation with configurable style and depth

Island.description: Island landform generation with ocean falloff

Use for desert biome base shapes

Plates.description: Tectonic plate simulation for continental terrain

tips: Use as mask for blending center vs edges
Use as mask for directional effects

Use as input mask or flat base
Use to bring in painted zone masks

Use for road paths or custom feature placement

Erosion2 is generally preferred for new work
Quick way to add erosion with tested presets

Creates talus slopes at base of cliffs

Thermal2.description: Advanced thermal erosion with more control

ThermalShaper.description: Thermal erosion shaping for slope refinement

Apply after erosion to fill valleys with deposited material

Anastomosis.description: Stream anastomosis — creates braided channel patterns

Lichtenberg.description: Lichtenberg fractal pattern formation — lightning/river branching

Use River output as mask for water placement in UE

Lake.description: Lake/water body formation based on terrain depression

Snow.description: Snow coverage simulation with melt and settlement
tips: Use Snow output as mask for white material in UE

Snowfield.description: Persistent snowfield simulation with directional wind

Trees.description: Tree placement mask driven by geology
tips: Use output as mask for foliage placement in UE

Adjust.description: General value adjustment with optional auto-leveling
tips: Quick way to normalize terrain values

Autolevel.description: Automatic level normalization — stretches values to full 0-1 range
tips: Always use before export to maximize heightmap range

Clamp.description: Constrains height values to a specified range

Blur.description: Gaussian blur filtering — softens terrain features

High radius blurs large-scale features

Sharpen.description: Edge sharpening for terrain detail enhancement

Fold.description: Wave-based fold simulation with sine/triangle/sawtooth waveforms

tips: Use to refine overall terrain silhouette

SoftClip.description: Soft clipping function — gently limits peak values

Warp.description: General warping deformation — distorts terrain based on noise or input

Threshold.description: Binary thresholding — creates hard mask from height values

GraphicEQ.description: Graphic equalizer curves for frequency-based terrain adjustment
tips: Fine-tune terrain frequency bands like an audio EQ

SlopeBlur.description: Slope-aware blurring — softens based on terrain slope

Distance.description: Distance field generation from terrain features

FractalTerraces.description: Fractal terrace formation with natural variation

TextureBase.description: Base texture derivation from terrain shape — foundation for coloring

WaterColor.description: Water-specific coloring for lakes and rivers

Splat.description: Splat map generation for multi-material terrain rendering

FlowMap.description: Flow map generation for water effects

Soil.description: Soil distribution mapping based on terrain features

Mask.description: Masking operations — isolate areas of terrain
